Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and trying Redwood! Quick note with three small options so we can get you a focused demo without back-and-forth. Pick whichever works and we’ll send a calendar invite. If you need an engineer on the call (for architecture/latency deep-dive), reply with the word ENG and we’ll prioritize an engineer for the slot.

Three suggested 30-min windows (your timezone):
- Tue Mar 29, 10:00–10:30 AM PT — fast overview + Q&A
- Wed Mar 30, 2:00–2:30 PM PT — architecture and rollout discussion
- Thu Mar 31, 9:00–9:30 AM PT — low-latency demo and cost walk-through

Pick a time via this one-click link: https://cal.redwood.ai/b/soojin/3w3kq
Or reply with the time you prefer and we’ll do the rest. Attached: an availability carousel image for quick reference and a short agenda PDF.

If you want us to include an engineer, reply ENG and Ben (cc’d) will coordinate an engineer-first slot.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
